# Recomp Achievements SDK

The upstream `sdk/` and license are vendored verbatim from [RecompAchievements at faf094acdf1efb57d8db7c8187b4b47aa1501805](https://github.com/elripalda/RecompAchievements/tree/faf094acdf1efb57d8db7c8187b4b47aa1501805). Dyna Brothers uses its game-side C library for the local RecompLauncher session channel.

The [SDK license](LICENSE) covers distribution in or with a game. The bundled [cJSON](sdk/third_party/cjson/LICENSE) and [rcheevos](sdk/third_party/rcheevos/LICENSE) sources have separate MIT notices.
